thought.text: The login form POSTs `user` and `pass`. Let me test a full end-to-end LDAP login with a test user to confirm the DB + LDAP + PHP stack works together.

reasoning_content:
The login page has `user` and `pass` fields. Let's test an actual LDAP login using the test user (user1/password1). The login POSTs to the same page. Let's do a complete login flow.

Let's look at how the login works — what URL to POST to, and what the session looks like. Let's test a complete login using the LDAP user.

action.command: cd /workspace && JAR=/tmp/cj.txt; rm -f $JAR; echo "=== POST login user1/password1 (LDAP user) ==="; curl -s -c $JAR -b $JAR -o /tmp/loginresp.html -D /tmp/loginhead.txt -w "HTTP %{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n" -H "Host: tfm-fachplanung.ddev.site" --data "user=user1&pass=password1&login-submit=Login" http://127.0.0.1:32789/login; echo "--- headers ---"; grep -iE "location|set-cookie" /tmp/loginhead.txt; echo "--- body head ---"; head -c 300 /tmp/loginresp.html
